_comment: Display text for Codex UI (agents/openai.yaml and .codex-plugin interface). short_description: 25-64 characters. default_prompt must name the skill as $skill-name. Generated files come from tools/build_manifests.py; edit here, not there. when: a short cue per skill for the session-start routing line.

engineering-lifecycle.shortDescription: Design judgment, code changes, review, merges

professional-craft.shortDescription: Writing that reads as human; decks, charts, pages
defaultPrompt: Make this sound like a person wrote it.
Build a deck that lands the ask.
Follow the core working rules for this task.

changing-code: Learn why code exists before changing it
Use $changing-code to fix this failing test without undoing a deliberate change.
reviewing-code: Prioritised review with a clear verdict
Use $reviewing-code to review this diff and give a verdict.
merging-safely: Prove a merge is complete, not just clean
Use $merging-safely to merge this branch and prove nothing was dropped.
writing-for-people: Writing that reads as a person wrote it
Use $writing-for-people to rewrite this so it sounds like us, not a template.
making-visuals: Decks, charts and pages checked at real size
Use $making-visuals to turn this into slides that land the ask.
shaping-designs: Constraints, options, contracts, data, failure modes
Use $shaping-designs to work out how we should build this.

when.writing-for-people: anything a person will read: emails, posts, docs, briefs, copy; or making text sound less like AI (not one-line grammar fixes)
when.making-visuals: slides, charts, diagrams, dashboards, pages, checking how one renders, or a screenshot as proof
when.shaping-designs: how to build or change something: designs, APIs, data, migrations, requirements, X or Y
when.changing-code: any change to existing code: fixes, debugging, incidents, refactors, upgrades, tests
when.reviewing-code: any opinion on code, a diff or a PR
when.merging-safely: merging branches, resolving conflicts, checking a fix landed
